name: WriteToExcelArrayValuesNode
label: Write Array Values to Excel
description: Writes an array of values to consecutive cells in an Excel worksheet, either horizontally or vertically.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet where the values will be written.

fields.name: Values
fields.label: Values
fields.description: The array of values to write to the worksheet.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column where values will be written (letter or number).

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row where values will be written.

fields.name: WriteDirection
fields.label: Write Direction
fields.description: The direction to write the values: Horizontal (across columns) or Vertical (down rows).
